newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse closes lower after one-day rise.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse closes lower after one-day rise.

text.p: 1410 GMT - Losers outnumbered gainers on the Budapest Stock Exchange, pulling the BUX index lower after one day of rise.
* The BUX index closed at 5,118.60 points, down 69.29.
* Eight stocks closed higher, 23 ended lower and five remained steady.
* Spot share turnover totalled 3.04 billion forints.
